title: Highway Congestion Reduction through Reinforcement Learning Based Eulerian Headway Control
abstract: arXiv:2412.02520v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Connected automated vehicles (CAVs) equipped with adaptive cruise control (ACC) create new opportunities for highway congestion mitigation. Traditional practice relies on Eulerian variable speed limits (VSL) which regulate traffic through roadside signs, but suffer from infrequent updates and limited driver compliance. Recent research explored Lagrangian strategies that directly control individual vehicles, offering high reactivity and compliance, yet in realistic multi-lane settings they depend on drivers' latent lane-change intentions, making robust vehicle-level decisions difficult. Hence, we propose an Eulerian control system optimized through reinforcement learning, that (i) leverages ACC for reactivity and compliance, and (ii) obviates dependence on latent driver intentions by regulating aggregate density near bottlenecks, crucially via headway commands rather than speed commands. translated_title: 基于强化学习的欧拉车头时距控制降低高速公路拥堵
translated_abstract: 配备自适应巡航控制（ACC）的联网自动车辆（CAVs）为缓解高速公路拥堵创造了新的机会。传统实践依赖于欧拉可变限速（VSL），通过路边标志调节交通，但存在更新频率低和驾驶员合规性有限的问题。近期研究探索了直接控制个体车辆的拉格朗日策略，提供了高响应性和合规性，但在现实多车道场景中，它们依赖于驾驶员的潜在换道意图，使得鲁棒的车辆级决策变得困难。因此，我们提出了一种通过强化学习优化的欧拉控制系统，该系统（i）利用ACC实现响应性和合规性，以及（ii）通过调节瓶颈附近的聚合密度，避免了对潜在驾驶员意图的依赖，关键是使用车头时距指令而非速度指令。我们评估了该系统的两种变体。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于强化学习的欧拉车头时距控制系统，结合ACC技术调节瓶颈区域密度，在不依赖驾驶员换道意图的情况下有效降低高速公路拥堵。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning-based Eulerian headway control system that leverages ACC to regulate bottleneck density, reducing highway congestion without relying on latent driver intentions.
